title: Supervisor, Technical Writer
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Supervisor, Technical Writer supports USP’s global Advanced Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) and Resiliency Center work by developing clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials for external use. This role translates scientific, technical, and operational information for external audiences and supports alignment between content development and community engagement activities. The Supervisor, Technical Writer collaborates with technical experts, project leads, and communications stakeholders across regions and supervises the Community Engagement Specialist.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Supervisor, Technical Writer has the following responsibilities:

* Develop written content such as articles, briefs, reports, blogs, presentations, case studies, and other communication materials supporting AMT and Supply Chain Solutions initiatives.
* Translate complex scientific, technical, manufacturing, and supply chain information — including technical outlines, interview notes, research findings, meeting summaries, and subject matter expert input — into clear, accurate, and accessible written materials for external audiences.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and project teams to gather information, validate technical accuracy, and incorporate feedback throughout the content development process.
* Support market-facing, educational, conference, and sales enablement materials that communicate USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center expertise, programs, services, and public health mission.
* Edit and refine draft materials to improve clarity, consistency, readability, and audience relevance.
* Apply USP brand standards, messaging priorities, and scientific quality expectations to written materials.
* Supervise the Community Engagement Specialist and support alignment between technical content and community engagement activities.
* Other duties as assigned

**Strategic Value**

* Supports USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center visibility in international and commercial markets by turning internal technical expertise into clear, practical materials for external audiences.
* Strengthens credibility and supports inbound interest by helping USP communicate AMT and Resiliency Center work in a consistent, audience-appropriate way.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate strong writing and communication skills, along with the ability to work effectively with technical subject matter experts and diverse stakeholders.
* Minimum qualifications include a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least four years of related experience in technical writing, scientific communications, content development, or a similar role supporting technical or scientific audiences.
* Experience developing written content such as articles, briefs, white papers, reports, presentations, or similar materials.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or scientific concepts into content that is clear, accurate, and accessible to broader audiences.
* Experience supporting content development that involves input from multiple subject matter experts and stakeholders, including synthesizing technical feedback and incorporating it into clear, accurate written materials.
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple content assignments and deliver high-quality work within established timelines.
* Self-directed work style with the ability to take ownership of assignments, move work forward with minimal direction, and exercise sound judgment in clarifying priorities when needed.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, including the ability to clarify direction, synthesize incomplete information, and move assignments forward in evolving project environments.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Experience working with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical manufacturing, healthcare, life sciences, supply chain, or other technical subject areas.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Directly supervises the Community Engagement Specialist.

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

**Job Category** Publications

**Job Type** Full-Time

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Salesforce Critical Incident Center Communications Team seeks a Technical Writer with excellent communication and analytical skills to facilitate completion and delivery of customer facing documentation related to unplanned technical incidents.

The role is primarily focused on taking initial drafts of information provided by the Technology and Products division related to incidents and verifying sufficient information is available, then polishing the content and publishing the resulting documentation for customer consumption.

Additionally, follow-up efforts are required to ensure preventative actions listed in the documentation are completed and updated to final versions of the content.This role is for communicators with a solid understanding of the Salesforce technology and products, a passion for customer advocacy, outstanding communication skills, a high level of organization to enable multiple projects under way simultaneously and a focus on Salesforce’s key values of trust and transparency.Responsibilities:

Review initial draft of RCA documentation provided by Technology and Products and review the content for thoroughness and ease of understanding.

Understand complex technical issues and concepts related to critical incidents and translate them into “business-speak” for customer consumption.

Assess contents of RCA to determine if questions are left unanswered, details are unclear, or if the document is likely to address the customer’s needs.

Liaise with Technology and Product experts to clear up questions or doubts resulting from the initial draft in order to ensure customer satisfaction with final results.

Polish the contents in order to create a single “voice” of Salesforce, resulting in RCAs having the same overall flow and style so they read as though written by the same person/team.

Maintain a portfolio of RCAs for cataloging in order to create a searchable library of content that internal teams can use to find incident related information when needed.

Track actions called out in RCAs and communicate with Technology and Product teams to verify actions are being completed in a timeframe outlined in the RCA. Update previously-published RCAs to show progress against noted actions.

Requirements:

4-8 years of experience in areas of incident management or technical writing

Outstanding writing, editing, and verbal communications skills

Understanding and experience in cloud infrastructure and platforms, such as AWS and GCP

Ability to learn and deeply understand technical information and concepts, especially as it relates to database architecture, security, networks, and customer relationship management principles

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, in sometimes high-pressure, or stressful situations, while successfully balancing multiple priorities

Ability to synthesize technical and non-technical details from different teams and determine which information is most relevant for different audiences

Excruciating attention to detail, a commitment to quality, and dogged perseverance to meet deadlines

Ability to work in a self-paced environment, strictly adhering to deadlines

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, or other related area

Desired Experience and Skills:

Experience with Salesforce platforms. Trailhead Ranger status and Salesforce certifications are a plus

Experience crafting customer-facing communications

Project/program and change management skills
